sentences.text:
Rakesh Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U P And 11 Others on 16
February, 2023

Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 43
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 10308 of 2022
Petitioner :- Rakesh Gupta And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U P And 11 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Abhinav Gaur,Ankit Shukla,Pavan Kumar Mishra,Sr

. Advocate Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one is present to press the present petition.

The present petition has been preferred with the following prayer:
"I. Issue an appropriate writ, order or direction quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 18.07.2022 lodged by the respondent no.3 in Case Crime No.289 of 2022, under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 272 and 273 IPC read with Section 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, Police Station Sumerpur, District Hamirpur (Annexure-1) II.

Issue an appropriate writ, order or direction commanding the Respondent no.2/Respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the First Rakesh Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U P And 11 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193171217/
